item.title: Saint Harison Talks New ‘Ghosted’ EP, Touring With Sam Smith & Writing That ‘I Hate Beyoncé’ Lyric: ‘This Is the Realest S—t I’ve Ever Written’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music trends and interviews. Today, we're shining the spotlight on rising British singer-songwriter Saint Harison. His new EP, "Ghosted", is out now, and it's a hauntingly beautiful look at the demise of a tumultuous romance.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: Saint Harison's journey to creating "Ghosted" began after releasing his 2023 EP, "Lost a Friend", which focused on friendship. But this time, he's exploring the darker side of love. In a recent interview with Billboard, Harison shared that the project was inspired by his experiences dating in Los Angeles and the emotional rollercoaster that followed.
[Music transitions to a clip from Saint Harison's EP]
Host: "Ghosted" features collaborations with notable producers like Akeel Henry, D'Mile, and Nova Wav, who have worked with big names like Beyoncé. The EP is a masterclass in storytelling, with Harison's vocals and lyrics taking center stage. He even tackles themes of regret, emotional shutdown, and ultimately, finding peace.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: What's interesting is that Harison scrapped his initial project, feeling it didn't meet his standards. He's been open about his struggles with mental health and used this experience as a catalyst for growth. He's even started therapy and has been working on fine-tuning his songwriting approach.
[Music transitions to a clip from Saint Harison's EP]
Host: Saint Harison's music is not only a reflection of his personal experiences but also a testament to his unique songwriting style. With "Ghosted", he's exploring new sounds, including notes of '60s soul-pop. And, as a fun fact, he even got to learn from Sam Smith during their residency together in San Francisco.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Saint Harison's "Ghosted" EP is out now, and it's definitely worth a listen. Tune in next time for more music news and interviews. Thanks for joining us!
